main_text.p: גִּזְבָּר m. Chald. Quæstor, Præfectus ærario.
גָּזַז Tondere, Abscindere, Resecare. Niphal נִגְּזוּ, Tondi.
גֵּז m. גִּזָּה f. Vellus, lana detonsa.
גְּזִית f. Cæsio, Lapis cæsus & politus.
גָּזַל Rapuit, Diripuit. Niphal, נִגְזַל Rapi.
גָּזֵל, גָּזָל, גָּזָל m. גְּזֵלָה f. Raptum, Rapina.
גָּזַר Secuit, Scidit, Abscidit: Decidit, Decrevit. Niphal נִגְזַר Exscindi, Succidi: Decerni. Chald. Ithpehal, הִתְגַּזַּר Excisus est, Dan.2.42.
גָּזֵר m. Segmentum: Fæmin. גְּזֵרָה Decisio. Chald. Decretum, בְּגְזֵרַת עִיר Ex decreto vigilum, Dan.4.14.
גְּזֵרָה f. Segmentum, Excisio: Septum, Tabulatum separatum, ab alio quasi Decisum.
גַּחֶלֶת m. גַּחֶלֶת f. Pruna, Carbo: plur. גֲּחָלִים.
גָּחוֹן גַּחוֹן m. Venter, reptilium proprie.

page.notes: Hebrew vocalisation and the running head are read from a small scan; the pointing of several entries is doubtful and is not marked individually. Entries 11 and 15, and the running head, are particularly uncertain.
